title: Implement POST /api/export/[slug] route
description: Create the API route that triggers site export for a prospect. Runs the export engine to generate a static HTML bundle and updates the prospect with the export URL.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/export/[slug] triggers export for a ready prospect
Returns 400 if prospect is not in 'ready' status
Export engine generates a static bundle and saves it
Prospect record is updated with export_url
Verify by calling endpoint and checking the export file exists

steps.details: Export POST handler. Load prospect by slug. If status != 'ready', return 400. Call `exportEngine.generate(prospect)`. Get the zip/folder URL. Update prospect `export_url`. Return 200 `{ exportUrl }`.
Generate a prospect first. Then POST /api/export/[slug]. Verify 200 response. Verify the export file exists at the returned URL.
